blocks.heading: Interview Scheduling Polite Rejections
rows: Clear communication
Job messages, interview scheduling, polite rejections
A set of three sample candidate emails
Accurate records
Candidate and employee files, attendance and leave
A tracker with fields, filters and no blank rows
Recruitment steps
Sourcing, screening, interviewing, offering, onboarding
A mock hiring plan for one role
Spreadsheet skill
Reports, headcount, simple dashboards
A pivot table report from sample data
Labour rule awareness
Leave, working hours, notice, statutory forms
A one-page summary with the official source named
Fairness and confidentiality
Handling complaints, salary data and personal records
A written handling rule you would follow

blocks.heading: Mock Interview Record That Shows Structure
rows: Before
Read the job description and list three must-have skills
Whether your questions test those skills
During
Ask the same core questions in the same order
Whether notes record facts, not impressions
After
Score against the must-haves and write a short summary
Whether the decision can be explained fairly
